response.sql: WITH j AS (SELECT o.ordertune AS t, COUNT(*) AS c FROM orderexecutions e JOIN orders o ON o.recordvault = e.ordersmark GROUP BY o.ordertune), s AS (SELECT t, c, c * 1.0 / SUM(c) OVER () AS share FROM j), a AS (SELECT s.*, AVG(share) OVER () AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT SUM(c) AS total_count, AVG(share) AS avg_share_above, AVG(share - avg_share) AS avg_excess FROM a WHERE share > avg_share
